## Discoveries

[Old Bain's Boat-Hook](../world/discoveries.md#old-bains-boat-hook), [Baysight](../world/discoveries.md#baysight), [The Pinch's Rotten Gates](../world/discoveries.md#rotten-sea-gates), [The Lighthouse Through the Trees](../world/discoveries.md#lighthouse-through-the-trees), [The Sea-Hole](../world/discoveries.md#the-sea-hole), [The Bell in the Cliff](../world/discoveries.md#the-bell-in-the-cliff), [Marram Cove's Post Box](../world/discoveries.md#marram-post-box)

Regional mastery, earned by making discoveries here:

- **Harbour Eyes** (2 discoveries): 400 mesos
- **Bain Born and Bred** (4 discoveries): 800 mesos, Skill: [Sea Legs](../skills/tutors.md#sea-legs)

A taxi from `harbour_cabman` takes you to any other town for 150 mesos.
